newsitem.title: USA: AMR's American Air cancels Dallas flights.
newsitem.headline: AMR's American Air cancels Dallas flights.

text.p: AMR Corp's American Airlines said snow storms and icy conditions in north Texas had forced it to cancel more than 200 flights in and out of Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport on Monday.
"Upwards of 200 departures and arrivals at Dallas-Fort Worth will be cancelled today," spokesman Tim Smith said in a recorded message.
Other American Airlines flights were being delayed by de-icing operations at the airport, Smith said.
